title: Font Manager character-set file
description: Language presets: the characters a font must cover to set a language. One file per script group; every *.json file in data/charsets except this schema follows it.

chars.description: Characters separated by one space. Each item is exactly one Unicode scalar value, written precomposed (NFC) where Unicode has a precomposed form. No item appears twice.

code.description: BCP 47 tag: ISO 639 language, optionally with an ISO 15924 script (sr-Cyrl). Unique across all files.

name.description: English name shown in the UI ("Serbian (Cyrillic)").

script.description: ISO 15924 script code (Latn, Cyrl, Hans, Jpan, Kore).

otLanguage.description: OpenType language-system tag, without padding (SRB, TRK). Used to look for locl forms.

base.description: Characters required to set the language. A font supports the language when it covers all of them.

auxiliary.description: Characters seen in loanwords, names or older spelling. Reported, never required. No overlap with base.

source.description: Where the base set comes from: hyperglot, google-fonts (Google Fonts language data), or project (curated here; see README).
